whatWeBuild.heading: What we build
whatWeBuild.intro: Tell us how you work today, spreadsheets and all. We build around it.

rows.thing: Websites that load fast on a phone
rows.detail: A clear home for what you do, on the screen your customers actually use.
Sell products, tickets, sign-ups or memberships. The money goes straight to your account, never through ours.
Appointments, classes, events and registrations, taken online at any hour.
A private sign-in where people see their own orders, bookings and history.
When a website is not enough, we build the app and get it into the app stores.
Keep working in Google Sheets or Excel. Upload the file and the site updates.
For leagues, tours and clubs. Scores go in during the event and standings update on every phone.
Reports, rankings and forecasts built on your own numbers.

items.detail: Your domain, your content and your data are yours, whether or not you keep working with us.
You get a year-by-year estimate before any work starts.
Hosting, domains and card fees are billed to you by the provider, at cost.
We are a call or a text away on your busiest days.

products.heading: Our own products
products.intro: We build and run two products of our own. They are where we try things first.

about.heading: About ScoutIQ
about.body: ScoutIQ is a small studio in Oshkosh, Wisconsin. We started in 2025 with two products of our own, then began building websites and apps for other people's businesses, clubs and leagues. The work draws on six years of professional data science and a background in web and mobile development.

contact.heading: Tell us what you run.
contact.sentence: A shop, a service, a club, a league, an idea. Send a few lines about it and what is not working today, and we will write back.
